svg.title: The disc method about the line y = 1: the region between y = x² and y = 1
svg.desc: Left: the region between the parabola y = x² and the line y = 1, from x = −1 to 1, shaded, with the line y = 1 dashed as the axis of rotation. One thin vertical rectangle reaches from the parabola up to the axis; its length is 1 − x². Right: the solid made by revolving the region about y = 1, shaped like a lemon: thickest in the middle and coming to points at x = ±1, with the axis through its center. The highlighted blue disc has radius r = 1 − x², the distance from the axis down to the curve, not x². V = the integral from −1 to 1 of π(1 − x²)² dx = 16π/15.
svg.text: The radius runs from the axis
to the curve: r = 1 − x2, not x2.
V = ∫ from −1 to 1 of π(1 − x2)2 dx
